name: Browse products and send a WhatsApp enquiry
description: Verifies visitors can browse the product catalogue and start a product-specific enquiry.
steps: Choose Enquire on WhatsApp for Dangote Cement
expected: The product page displays all four materials and the enquiry action opens a WhatsApp message for the selected material.

name: Explore services including POS and NIN registration
description: Verifies the services page displays the business's materials, POS services, and NIN registration assistance with enquiry actions.
expected: The services page shows all six services, and the POS and NIN enquiry actions open WhatsApp messages about the selected service.

name: Read the business story and FAQs
description: Verifies the About page describes the business and the FAQ explains how to check current prices.
expected: The About page describes the local building materials business, and the FAQ says to contact the business for current pricing because prices can change.

name: Find store location and contact details on mobile
description: Verifies mobile visitors can find the exact supplied location and use the contact links.
steps: Review the address and contact details
expected: The page shows Uroho 3 Community, opposite Town Hall, both phone numbers, and the email address; tapping a phone number starts a call action.
